text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
I've replied to Hollis in the DM. Moss's notes give two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#4419**, from Moss's undated North cheat sheet. Thea Ramaswell logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.
- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" note of 5 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments when they checked in. It was patched on 4 Oct 2025, and Thea confirmed the fix the next day.

Two other Moss notes mention the account but have no ticket numbers: the North pipeline digest (14 Sep 2025) and the renewal check-in (23 Mar 2026).

I told Hollis about one mismatch to check before the deck goes out. Marcus Lindqvist's own note from 14 Jul 2025 also lists #4419, but describes it as a printer delay at Gate 3, not a scanner problem.

I only used public files that Hollis can open himself. I didn't read the #inc-qfl-sev1 incident channel because Hollis isn't a member, so any ticket numbers there aren't in the list.
